mission.title: Transcendence
mission.description: Extract a potential Redpill that has already become self-aware of the Matrix.
mission.neighbourhoods: Dannah Heights, Kedemoth, Lemone, Magog, Mannsdale Housing Projects, Zia

phase.briefing:
Rarely, there are some people who become aware of the Matrix without having taken the red pill. We call them the "Self-Substantiated" and if not handled properly, they can become a danger to themselves and those around them.
We need you to investigate a man named Owen Hartley who may be Self-Substantiated. Good luck. Zion's future rests on your success!

enter.say: This is where Owen Hartley lives. Interview his roommates. He lives with two young ladies. Remember, the Self-Substantiated are desirable targets for both Machine and Exile operatives. They can also be very dangerous in their own right.

phase.briefing: Okay, we're on the right track. Owen Hartley is supposed to be here, but we can't be too sure. Watch yourself -- this place looks like it's crawling with programs and Exiles. I have the information on at least two of them so it would be best if you took them out. They are Sabine and Kernel.

enter.say: This is the place. Be careful. Expect anything!

objective.text: Lead Lisa Moreno to Owen Hartley
Do not let Lisa Moreno die

phase.briefing: The other team is already engaged in another pickup, so get in, grab the medical gear you need, and get back to Owen Hartley! Quickly!

enter.say: The team you need is in here.

objective.text: Pick up the Medical Supplies from Capella

phase.briefing: Now get back to Owen Hartley. His current location will be pointed out to you. Once you give him the Medical Supplies, make an immediate extraction.

enter.say: Hmm, bad news ... It looks like another team is in the building. They're humans, but I'd bet a box of Yummy Oats that the Machines hired them. You're going to have to get past them to get to Owen Hartley.

objective.text: Give the Medical Supplies to Owen Hartley
Lead Owen Hartley out of the building.
